faq.q: What welding standards apply to Titanium Deep-Sea Release Hook Pin for marine applications?
faq.a: Titanium Deep-Sea Release Hook Pin is welded per AWS D1.6 (Structural Welding Code — Titanium) with shielding gas purity ≥99.995% Argon and trailing shield protection. Weld zone oxygen pickup is limited to <500 ppm to maintain ductility. For deepsea instrument release, 100% radiographic or ultrasonic inspection of weld zones is standard per ASME Section IX requirements.
